Content Update 3.30.0 — Path of Exile: Covens of Umbra


Table of Contents

  • Skill Gem Changes
  • Ascendancy Changes

Ascendancy Changes

  • The Pathfinder's Master Distiller Notable Passive Skill now Grant bonuses to Non-Channelling Skills you use by consuming 3 Charges from a Flask of each of the following types, if possible:
    • If Bismuth Flask Charges are consumed, Penetrate 30% Elemental Resistances (previously 25%).
    • If Diamond Flask Charges are consumed, +100% to Critical Strike Multiplier (previously 250% increased Critical Strike Chance).
  • The Pathfinder's Master Surgeon Notable Passive Skill now has 50% less Life Flask Recovery Rate (previously 50% less Life Recovery from Flasks).

Return to top

Skill Gem Changes

  • Winter Orb: Now fires 2 Projectiles at all gem levels (previously 2-3 at gem levels 1-20), and has 70% Effectiveness of Added Damage (previously 80%).
  • Summon Stone Golem: Golems now grant 16% increased Defences (previously 20%).
  • Blood Shrine of Crows now grants significantly higher Chaos Resistance.
